needs_human.note: The submodule bump changes Ask tab behaviour (thread, New conversation, Save as Markdown) and the /files/{id}/ask contract (history), with no spec in this change.; The ConditionMenu label now shows at phone width; no design decision (D1–D12) states this.; FolderBrowser.handleSceneToggle builds the URL from props rather than the current URL params, so any parameter the page does not model (for example img) is dropped on toggle; the old page-level toggle copied every parameter.
The ConditionMenu label is now visible at phone width, and no spec item covers it.; The submodule bump ships the Ask thread, file-question history and storyboard retry behaviour without a core spec.
